articles.headline: Bucs GM Jason Licht 'optimistic' about re-signing Baker Mayfield
articles.description: Buccaneers general manager Jason Licht said Friday that he is "very optimistic" about quarterback Baker Mayfield playing in Tampa beyond the 2026 season despite Mayfield saying he felt "disrespected" by what the Bucs initially offered.

articles.headline: Bucs rookie QB Jalon Daniels gets a surprise start but falters in preseason loss at Jaguars
articles.description: Jalon Daniels’ chances of earning Tampa Bay’s backup quarterback job seemed to diminish in the team’s preseason finale, a 19-0 loss at Jacksonville on Friday night in which neither side played starters.

articles.headline: Tua Tagovailoa leads TD drive and loses fumble in Falcons' 17-12 preseason win over Dolphins
articles.description: — Tua Tagovailoa led a touchdown drive but lost a fumble while playing the first quarter for Atlanta against his former team, and the Falcons beat the Miami Dolphins 17-12 on Friday night.

articles.headline: Miles Davis' TD run lifts Panthers to 16-13 win over Texans in preseason finale
articles.description: — Rookie Miles Davis ran for a 1-yard touchdown, Ryan Fitzgerald kicked three field goals and the Carolina Panthers held on to defeat the Houston Texans 16-13 on Friday night in the preseason finale for both teams.

articles.headline: Broncos' Marvin Mims Jr. exits preseason game with foot injury
articles.description: Broncos wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr. left the team's preseason finale Friday night with a right foot injury and was not expected to return to the game.

articles.headline: Jets RB Chip Trayanum taken to hospital with neck injury
articles.description: Jets rookie running back Chip Trayanum was taken to a hospital with a neck injury after being tackled on the final play of the first half against the Giants on Friday night.
